titleZh: 特朗普在巴特勒的集会
summaryEn: Musk's full speech endorsing Trump, calling the election a must-win for preserving free speech and democracy.
summaryZh: 马斯克发表完整演讲支持特朗普，称为了维护言论自由和民主，这场选举必须获胜。

segments.textEn: His name is Elon Musk. He saved free speech. He created so many different great things. Where? Where is he? Come on up here, Elon. He created the first major American car company in generations. And his rocket company is the only reason we can now send American astronauts into space. Come here. Take over, Eli. Yes, Take over.
segments.textZh: 他的名字是埃隆·马斯克。他拯救了言论自由。他创造了如此多各不相同的伟大事物。在哪儿？他在哪儿？上来吧，埃隆。他创办了几代人以来第一家美国大型汽车公司。而他的火箭公司是我们现在能够把美国宇航员送入太空的唯一原因。过来。交给你了，伊莱。对，交给你了。

segments.textEn: Thank you.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。

segments.textEn: Hi, everyone.
segments.textZh: 大家好。

segments.textEn: As you can see, I'm. I'm not just Maga, I'm Doc Maga. Well, first of all, I want to say what an honor it is to be here. And you know, the true test of someone's character is how they behave under fire.
segments.textZh: 如你们所见，我是。我不只是MAGA，我是Doc MAGA。嗯，首先，我想说，能来到这里是多么荣幸。你们知道，对一个人品格的真正考验，是他在枪火之下如何表现。

segments.textEn: And we had one president who couldn't climb a flight of stairs and another who was fist pumping after getting shot.
segments.textZh: 我们有一位总统连一段楼梯都爬不上去，另一位中枪后却在挥拳。

segments.textEn: Fight, fight, fight. Blood coming down the face.
segments.textZh: 战斗，战斗，战斗。鲜血从脸上流下来。

segments.textEn: Now, America is the home of the brave.
segments.textZh: 现在，美国是勇者之家。

segments.textEn: And there's no truer test than courage under fire. So who do you want representing America?
segments.textZh: 没有什么比枪火之下的勇气更能检验人的本色。那么，你们希望谁代表美国？

segments.textEn: Yeah, absolutely.
segments.textZh: 对，绝对是。

segments.textEn: And I think this election, I think it's the most important election of our lifetime.
segments.textZh: 我认为这场选举，我认为这是我们一生中最重要的选举。

segments.textEn: This is no ordinary election.
segments.textZh: 这不是一场普通的选举。

segments.textEn: The other side wants to take away your freedom of speech. They want to take away your right to bear arms.
segments.textZh: 另一方想夺走你们的言论自由。他们想夺走你们持有武器的权利。

segments.textEn: They want to take away your right to vote. Effectively, you got 14 states now that don't require voter ID. California, where are you? Slovenia is just passed a law banning voter ID for voting.
segments.textZh: 他们想夺走你们的投票权。实际上，现在有14个州不要求出示选民身份证。加利福尼亚州，你在哪里？斯洛文尼亚刚刚通过了一项法律，禁止在投票时要求出示选民身份证。

segments.textEn: I still can't believe that's real.
segments.textZh: 我仍然无法相信这是真的。

segments.textEn: So how are you supposed to have a good, proper election if there's no id? It's just meaningless.
segments.textZh: 所以，如果没有身份证，你们怎么可能举行一场良好、正规的选举？这根本毫无意义。

segments.textEn: And free speech is the bedrock of democracy.
segments.textZh: 而言论自由是民主的基石。

segments.textEn: And if people don't know what's going on, if they don't know the truth, how can you make an informed vote? You must have free speech in order to have democracy. That's why it's the First Amendment.
segments.textZh: 如果人们不知道正在发生什么，如果他们不知道真相，又怎么能作出知情的投票决定？要有民主，就必须有言论自由。这就是为什么它是第一修正案。

segments.textEn: And the Second Amendment is there to ensure that we have the First Amendment.
segments.textZh: 而第二修正案的存在，是为了确保我们拥有第一修正案。

segments.textEn: President Trump must win to preserve the Constitution. He must win to preserve democracy in America.
segments.textZh: 特朗普总统必须获胜，以维护宪法。他必须获胜，以维护美国的民主。

segments.textEn: Yes, This is a must win situation. Must win. So I have one. Ask for everyone in the audience, everyone who watches this video, everyone in the live stream, this one request. It's very important. Register to vote. Okay. And get everyone you know to. And everyone you don't know, drag them to register to vote. There's only two days left to register to vote in Georgia and Arizona. 48 hours.
segments.textZh: 是的，这是必须获胜的局面。必须获胜。所以我有一个。请求现场的每个人、观看这段视频的每个人、直播中的每个人做这一件事。这非常重要。登记投票。好吗。让你们认识的每个人也去登记。还有你们不认识的每个人，拉着他们去登记投票。距离佐治亚州和亚利桑那州的选民登记截止只剩2天。48小时。

segments.textEn: Like, text people now, now, and then make sure they actually do vote. If they don't, this will be the last election. That's my prediction. Nothing's more important. Nothing's more important.
segments.textZh: 比如，现在就给别人发短信，现在，然后确保他们确实去投票。如果他们不投，这将是最后一场选举。这是我的预测。没有什么更重要。没有什么更重要。

segments.textEn: So get everyone you know, Everyone. So I'm speaking to people out there. Everyone in the crowd, I think, is already convinced. But for people out there that are watching the video, watching the live stream, you need to get everyone you know at work, your friends, family, text groups, your social media, everything, get them to register to vote right now. Only two days left for Georgia and Arizona. Only a couple weeks left in Pennsylvania.
segments.textZh: 所以，让你们认识的每个人，每个人。现在我要对外面的人说。现场的每个人，我想，都已经被说服了。但对于外面那些正在观看视频、观看直播的人，你们需要让工作中认识的每个人、你们的朋友、家人、短信群组、社交媒体上的人，所有人，立刻去登记投票。佐治亚州和亚利桑那州只剩2天。宾夕法尼亚州只剩几周。

segments.textEn: And if they're not registered to vote, it doesn't matter at that point, register. But I'm being repetitive for a reason, okay? So nothing is more important.
segments.textZh: 如果他们没有登记投票，到那时就无所谓了，登记。但我反复说是有原因的，好吗？所以，没有什么更重要。

segments.textEn: And a lot of people think maybe the vote doesn't count. Well, it does, okay? It does. It matters. And this election could be decided by 1,000 votes, 500 votes, a tiny margin.
segments.textZh: 很多人认为，也许这一票不算数。嗯，算数，好吗？算数。它很重要。这场选举可能由1,000票、500票这样极小的差距决定。

segments.textEn: So get everyone you know to register to vote. I believe that's swapthevote.com I believe that's the site. And double check that your registration is good. Don't take it for granted.
segments.textZh: 所以，让你们认识的每个人都去登记投票。我相信是swapthevote.com，我相信是这个网站。还要再次确认你们的登记没有问题。不要想当然。

segments.textEn: I'm just being repetitive about this point because it is the one takeaway more than anything that will matter is getting those registrations and then getting everyone you know to actually vote. That is what will decide this election, especially in Pennsylvania.
segments.textZh: 我只是反复强调这一点，因为比任何事情都更值得记住、也更重要的一点，就是完成那些登记，然后让你们认识的每个人确实去投票。这将决定这场选举，尤其是在宾夕法尼亚州。

segments.textEn: So thank you. And honestly, you want to just be a pest? Just be a pest to everyone you know, people on the street everywhere. Vote, vote, vote. Fight, fight, fight. Vote, vote, vote. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 所以，谢谢。说真的，你们就想做个烦人精吗？那就去烦你们认识的每一个人，街上的人，到处的人。投票，投票，投票。战斗，战斗，战斗。投票，投票，投票。谢谢。
